notes.title: Dust Off Your Necronomicon and Pick up some Flowers!
notes.content:
Great news, humans and sunken city inhabitants! [b]Sucker for Love: Prelude[/b] is out now on Steam! Enjoy an unforgettable experience with the type of gal you just can't stop thinking of. 

[u][i]From the store page itself:[/i][/u]
Sucker for Love is a romantic visual novel with a dark twist. It's said that the heart and brain are often at odds, and SfL puts that to the test. As you woo this otherworldly beauty, try to keep your mind from spiraling into maddening insanity! Recite the incantations for the perfect date and stave off oblivion by:
[list]
[*] Performing dangerous rituals
[*] Keeping your possessive eldritch date happy
[*] Escaping from the horrors you unleash upon yourself
[/list]

[i]*Seriously I can't get her out of my head. Please send help.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820740/Sucker_for_Love_Prelude/

And don't forget to wishlist the page for [b]Sucker for Love: First Date[/b], coming early next year! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574270/Sucker_for_Love_First_Date/

notes.title: Get a Taste of Sucker for Love, Calamari Not Included
